what: A person who scrolls down a trial's Changes tab before the watchlist's list of trials to review has loaded is thrown back to the top of the page when that list arrives. The same jump leaves a race in the action-bar walk that ticket 01 set out to fix: if the list answers between the walk's scroll to the bottom and its read of the last change, the last change sits under the review bar and the walk goes red; now that a wobble turns the browser tests red, that is a red check on GitHub's slower machine. Ticket 01's note says the scroll reads were not racing; they still race this one thing. I ran it: with that list held back, I scrolled to the bottom, let the list load, and the page was back at the top, and the walk's last-change read failed (red at both window sizes). The cause is that the router scrolls to the top only after the trial page's drawing has finished, and that drawing now ends by waiting for the list, after the whole page is already on the screen.
